verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly cover connecting MCP servers to Copilot Chat in the IDE so it can use context and tools from other applications (github-docs-28). Further docs show Copilot Chat consuming the GitHub MCP server, configured remotely or locally in VS Code, which confirms the client-side MCP plumbing works. Missing for 10: detail beyond one-line summaries on configuring arbitrary third-party servers and on tool invocation, evidence of MCP client support in the cloud agent and Copilot CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
